review: 726.2-2: A held the initiative without ever having ventured (unreachable, taking it always ventures) and the 'nobody holds it' variant was unreachable with progress; put A's marker on Secret Entrance, made the upkeep venture move to Forge with counters on a new Grizzly Bears, rewrote the B-holds and never-taken variants to reachable states, dropped unused Plains.

726.2-3: B held the initiative with no dungeon progress (unreachable) and the no-holder variant kept that history; gave B a marker on Secret Entrance and reworded the no-holder variant as a game that never had the initiative.

726.3-1: B held the initiative without dungeon progress (unreachable) and the base expected claimed an event in B's later upkeep outside the scenario; gave B a Secret Entrance marker, restated the base outcome within the scenario, made the no-previous-holder variant a game that never had the initiative.
726.5-1: the opponent-holds variant left B holding the initiative with no history; stated that B took it by combat damage and ventured to Secret Entrance so the board is reachable.

scenarios.title: Whenever a player takes the initiative, that player ventures into Undercity

setup.notes: Nobody has the initiative and neither player has ventured into any dungeon. A's library holds a single basic land, Plains.

decisions: A casts Undermountain Adventurer, tapping four Forests.
Both players pass; Undermountain Adventurer resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; A takes the initiative.
The inherent trigger 'whenever a player takes the initiative, that player ventures into Undercity' goes on the stack; both players pass; A ventures and enters the first room, Secret Entrance.
A searches the library for a basic land card, choosing Plains, reveals it and puts it into hand.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A has the initiative. The venture trigger fires, A enters Secret Entrance in the Undercity dungeon, and A's hand contains Plains while the library is empty.

variants.label: no_initiative_taken
variants.delta: A casts Grizzly Bears (with two of the four Forests) instead of Undermountain Adventurer, so no player takes the initiative.
variants.expected: Nobody has the initiative. No venture trigger fires, A has not entered any dungeon, and Plains is still in A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: The initiative designation has no zone field in the setup schema, so it is stated in notes. Undermountain Adventurer's enters trigger is a TakeInitiative effect.

scenarios.title: At the beginning of the initiative holder's upkeep, that player ventures into Undercity

setup.notes: A has the initiative and A's venture marker is on Secret Entrance in Undercity (A ventured once when taking it). B has not ventured. Grizzly Bears has no counters.

decisions: The beginning-of-upkeep trigger of the initiative holder goes on the stack, controlled by A; both players pass; it resolves.
A ventures into Undercity and moves from Secret Entrance to the room Forge.
Forge's room ability targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The upkeep trigger fires. A's venture marker moves to Forge and Grizzly Bears becomes 4/4 with two +1/+1 counters. A still has the initiative.

variants.label: opponent_holds_it
variants.delta: B has the initiative instead of A (B took it from A by combat damage, and B's venture marker is on Secret Entrance).
variants.expected: No initiative trigger fires in A's upkeep. A's marker stays on Secret Entrance and Grizzly Bears stays 2/2 with no counters. B still has the initiative.

variants.label: never_taken
variants.delta: The initiative has never entered this game: nobody holds it and A has no dungeon progress.
variants.expected: No initiative trigger fires in A's upkeep. A is in no dungeon and Grizzly Bears stays 2/2 with no counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the initiative designation set directly, for example through a puzzle-state or by scripting a prior TakeInitiative effect.

scenarios.title: Combat damage to the initiative holder transfers the initiative to the damaging player

setup.notes: B has the initiative and B's venture marker is on Secret Entrance in Undercity (B ventured once when taking it). A has not ventured. Both Grizzly Bears have been under their controllers' control since before the turn began. A's library holds a single basic land, Plains.

decisions: A attacks B with Grizzly Bears.
B declares no blockers.
Combat damage is dealt: A's Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to B.

The inherent trigger 'whenever one or more creatures a player controls deal combat damage to the player who has the initiative' goes on the stack, controlled by A; both players pass and it resolves; A takes the initiative.
The trigger 'whenever a player takes the initiative' goes on the stack; both players pass; A ventures into Undercity, enters Secret Entrance, searches for a basic land and takes Plains into hand.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B is at 18 life. The damage trigger fires, controlled by A, and A takes the initiative; B no longer has it. The take-the-initiative trigger fires: A enters Secret Entrance and A's hand contains Plains.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B's Grizzly Bears blocks A's Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: B stays at 20 life; both Grizzly Bears die. No damage trigger fires, B keeps the initiative, and A has not entered any dungeon.

variants.label: never_taken
variants.delta: The initiative has never entered this game: nobody holds it and B has no dungeon progress.
variants.expected: B is at 18 life. No initiative trigger fires, nobody has the initiative, and A has not entered any dungeon; Plains stays in A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the initiative designation set directly on B. Forge implements the combat-damage transfer as a built-in game-state trigger.

scenarios.title: A player taking the initiative takes it away from the previous holder

setup.notes: B has the initiative and B's venture marker is on Secret Entrance in Undercity (B ventured once when taking it). A has not ventured. A's library holds a single basic land, Plains.

decisions: A casts Undermountain Adventurer, tapping four Forests.
Both players pass; Undermountain Adventurer resolves.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; A takes the initiative.
The venture trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; A ventures into Undercity, entering Secret Entrance, and takes Plains into hand.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A has the initiative and B no longer has it. A enters Secret Entrance and takes Plains into hand; B's marker stays on Secret Entrance.

variants.label: no_take
variants.delta: A casts Grizzly Bears (with two of the four Forests) instead of Undermountain Adventurer, so nobody takes the initiative.
variants.expected: B still has the initiative and A does not. A has not entered any dungeon and Plains stays in A's library.

variants.label: no_previous_holder
variants.delta: The initiative has never entered this game before Undermountain Adventurer's trigger: nobody holds it and B has no dungeon progress.
variants.expected: A has the initiative; nobody lost it. A enters Secret Entrance and takes Plains into hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the initiative designation set directly on B.

scenarios.title: Taking the initiative while holding it triggers the venture ability again

setup.notes: A has the initiative and A's venture marker is already on Secret Entrance in Undercity (A ventured once when taking it). B has not ventured. Grizzly Bears has no counters; A's library holds Plains.

decisions: A casts Undermountain Adventurer, tapping four Forests.
Both players pass; Undermountain Adventurer resolves.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; A takes the initiative while already holding it.
The trigger 'whenever a player takes the initiative' goes on the stack; both players pass; A ventures into Undercity and moves from Secret Entrance to the room Forge.
Forge's ability targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A still has the initiative (a single designation). The venture trigger fires: A moves to Forge and Grizzly Bears becomes 4/4 with two +1/+1 counters.

variants.label: no_take
variants.delta: A's hand holds a second Grizzly Bears (cast with two of the four Forests) instead of Undermountain Adventurer, so no take-the-initiative instruction is performed.
variants.expected: No venture trigger fires. A stays in Secret Entrance and the original Grizzly Bears has no counters.

variants.label: opponent_holds_it
variants.delta: B has the initiative instead of A (B took it from A by combat damage, and B's venture marker is on Secret Entrance); A's marker is still on Secret Entrance.
variants.expected: A takes the initiative from B; the venture trigger fires and A moves to Forge, with Grizzly Bears becoming 4/4. B no longer has the initiative.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the initiative designation and A's dungeon progress set directly.
